# Game Nuke Official

> Official technical and product documentation for Game Nuke Quasar Edition, an Android gaming performance and telemetry utility.

Canonical website: https://gamenukeofficial.com/
Primary language: English
Current release: v2.8.0-Quasar
Supported platform: Android 11–16, ARM64
Core access model: No root required for core features; elevated capabilities may use Shizuku or Wireless Debugging on compatible devices.

## What Game Nuke is
Game Nuke centralizes Android gaming utilities into one clean cockpit. The official website describes real-time telemetry (FPS, frame time, thermals, memory), touch responsiveness calibration, socket & DNS network stability, display controls, Shizuku-compatible execution modes, and a lightweight floating in-game cockpit.

## Official distribution
- Standalone Web Edition: https://gamenukeofficial.com/
- Direct APK Download: https://gamenukeofficial.com/download.html
- Google Play Edition: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.neon.gametweak
- Official WhatsApp Community: https://www.whatsapp.com/channel/0029Vb8OBaTJJhzc7lFIBe2D

## Important product context
Game Nuke is an independent Android utility project developed by Agung Developer. The utility operates strictly on the Android system utility layer and does not modify game installations or inject code into third-party game binaries.
